subject: Malaysia M-510 TiO2 for WILLCO facade finishes
body:
WILLCO's Silicoonharssierpleister KR technical sheet lists titanium dioxide in its silicone-resin/acrylic wall finish.

We manufacture Malaysia-origin M-510 rutile TiO2. Its TDS specifies zirconium/aluminium surface treatment and lists water-based wall latex paints; compatibility with your finish would need formulation assessment.

May I send the M-510 technical sheet for your product-development team's review?
